sentences.en: The brightest student expressed gratitude on behalf of his classmates.
sentences.zh: 最优秀的学生代表同学们表达了感激之情。

sentences.en: He gave me this doll in token of his gratitude.
sentences.zh: 他送给我这个洋娃娃以示感谢。

sentences.en: There was not a single word of gratitude from them.
sentences.zh: 他们没有说一句感谢的话。
